<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Gravel Guts](/Feats.aspx?ID=4176) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 110

**Archetype** [Stalwart Defender](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=205)

**Prerequisites**
[Stalwart Defender Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4172)

</column>

---

Stone never becomes queasy, so why should you? You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) condition. When you succeed at a Fortitude save to reduce your sickened value, you reduce it by 2 (or by 3 on a critical success).
name: Gravel Guts
